cards.meaning: dismissed, thrown out, scrapped (a charge, a case, a proposal)
cards.example: Ibinasura ng prosekusyon ang Article III laban sa Bise Presidente.
cards.exampleMeaning: The prosecution dropped Article III against the Vice President.
cards.note: Mula sa 'basura'; mas matigas at mas tiyak kaysa 'inalis'. Karaniwan sa balita tungkol sa korte at kongreso. Pangngalan: pagbasura.
cards.tiesTo: House prosecutors drop the bribery article

cards.example: Baon sa utang ang pambansang pamahalaan, ayon sa pagtataya para sa 2027.
cards.exampleMeaning: The national government is buried in debt, according to the 2027 projection.
cards.note: Kolokyal na idyoma; ang pormal na katumbas ay 'lubog sa utang'. Huwag ipagkamali sa 'baon' na pagkain.

cards.meaning: to tend toward, to converge on (a state)
cards.exampleMeaning: The decline in home prices is narrowing.
cards.note: 书面语: 趋于稳定/平缓/一致. Contrast 逐渐 (spoken, goes before a verb): 趋于 takes an adjective/state as its object.
cards.tiesTo: China home-price slide slowing to -3.0% y/y

cards.meaning: conversely, in turn (the effect feeds back on the cause)
cards.example: 价格下降刺激了需求，反过来又压缩了利润。
cards.examplePinyin: Jiàgé xiàjiàng cìjī le xūqiú, fǎnguòlái yòu yāsuō le lìrùn.
cards.exampleMeaning: Falling prices stimulated demand, which in turn squeezed profits.
cards.note: Advanced connective, neutral-to-written. Contrast 反而 (contrary to expectation) and 相反 (pure opposition): 反过来 describes a feedback loop.
cards.tiesTo: China PMI up while output prices fall
